$comment: SHARED, CANONICAL applied-appearance parity fixture for the bugfix
`bugfix-published-form-styling` (Phase 5 / Task 20). It is the ONE source of resolved
Look_And_Feel_Settings attributes that BOTH render paths are driven from so the two
provably use the SAME input:
- the PUBLISHED Python-rendered HTML (sam/shared/page_styles + application_form_render),
asserted by sam/tests/test_published_form_applied_styling_parity.py, and
- the React admin PREVIEW (ApplicationFormPreview.tsx + pageStyles.ts), asserted by
frontend/.../__tests__/ApplicationFormPreview.appliedParity.test.tsx.
CRITICAL (design E / Task 20): each test asserts the APPLIED RESULT on its path — the
brand colour reaches the form heading/submit/focus, the `columns` value produces the
SAME multi-column layout, and the logo + header title appear — NEVER merely that the two
generators emit the same string. The spec-15 task-13.2 string fixture
(page_styles_parity.json) is INSUFFICIENT and is part of this bug; this fixture is the
applied-appearance companion, not a replacement.
ONE file is canonical: sam/tests/fixtures/applied_appearance_parity.json. The frontend
test root carries a byte-identical vendored copy at
frontend/src/components/TenantAdmin/MembersConfig/__tests__/fixtures/applied_appearance_parity.json;
a guard test on EACH plane asserts the two copies are byte-for-byte identical so both
planes provably read the SAME attributes.
Every case carries distinct values (a brand colour differing from the SAM default, a
multi-column `columns`, a logo reference, and a header_title) so 'applied' is observable
on both paths. `default_primary` is #2D5F8A (sam/shared/page_styles._DEFAULTS /
pageStyles.ts DEFAULTS): a case's color_primary MUST differ from it.
